verses.en: L. M

verses.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رَّبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: (This is) the Revelation of the Book in which there is no doubt,- from the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُۚ بَلۡ هُوَ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّا٘ اَتٰىهُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He has forged it"? Nay, it is the Truth from thy Lord, that thou mayest admonish a people to whom no warner has come before thee: in order that they may receive guidance

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰي عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِؕ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا شَفِيۡعٍؕ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is Allah Who has created the heavens and the earth, and all between them, in six Days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): ye have none, besides Him, to protect or intercede (for you): will ye not then receive admonition

verses.ar: يُدَبِّرُ الۡاَمۡرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يَعۡرُجُ اِلَيۡهِ فِيۡ يَوۡمٍ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهٗ٘ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوۡنَ
verses.en: He rules (all) affairs from the heavens to the earth: in the end will (all affairs) go up to Him, on a Day, the space whereof will be (as) a thousand years of your reckoning

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الۡغَيۡبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: Such is He, the Knower of all things, hidden and open, the Exalted (in power), the Merciful

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡ٘ اَحۡسَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَبَدَاَ خَلۡقَ الۡاِنۡسَانِ مِنۡ طِيۡنٍۚ‏
verses.en: He Who has made everything which He has created most good: He began the creation of man with (nothing more than) clay

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسۡلَهٗ مِنۡ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنۡ مَّآءٍ مَّهِيۡنٍۚ‏
verses.en: And made his progeny from a quintessence of the nature of a fluid despised

verses.ar: ثُمَّ سَوّٰىهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِهٖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: But He fashioned him in due proportion, and breathed into him something of His spirit. And He gave you (the faculties of) hearing and sight and feeling (and understanding): little thanks do ye give

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلۡنَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِيۡ خَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍ ࣢ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And they say: "What! when we lie, hidden and lost, in the earth, shall we indeed be in a Creation renewed? Nay, they deny the Meeting with their Lord

verses.ar: قُلۡ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمۡ مَّلَكُ الۡمَوۡتِ الَّذِيۡ وُكِّلَ بِكُمۡ ثُمَّ اِلٰي رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Say: "The Angel of Death, put in charge of you, will (duly) take your souls: then shall ye be brought back to your Lord

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ تَرٰ٘ي اِذِ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ نَاكِسُوۡا رُءُوۡسِهِمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡؕ رَبَّنَا٘ اَبۡصَرۡنَا وَسَمِعۡنَا فَارۡجِعۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَالِحًا اِنَّا مُوۡقِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: If only thou couldst see when the guilty ones will bend low their heads before their Lord, (saying:) "Our Lord! We have seen and we have heard: Now then send us back (to the world): we will work righteousness: for we do indeed (now) believe

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَاٰتَيۡنَا كُلَّ نَفۡسٍ هُدٰىهَا وَلٰكِنۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ مِنِّيۡ لَاَمۡلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
verses.en: If We had so willed, We could certainly have brought every soul its true guidance: but the Word from Me will come true, "I will fill Hell with Jinns and men all together

verses.ar: فَذُوۡقُوۡا بِمَا نَسِيۡتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّا نَسِيۡنٰكُمۡ وَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ الۡخُلۡدِ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Taste ye then - for ye forgot the Meeting of this Day of yours, and We too will forget you - taste ye the Penalty of Eternity for your (evil) deeds

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِهَا خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوۡا بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَࣛۚ‏
verses.en: Only those believe in Our Signs, who, when they are recited to them, fall down in prostration, and celebrate the praises of their Lord, nor are they (ever) puffed up with pride

verses.ar: تَتَجَافٰي جُنُوۡبُهُمۡ عَنِ الۡمَضَاجِعِ يَدۡعُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ خَوۡفًا وَّطَمَعًاؗ وَّمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ
verses.en: Their limbs do forsake their beds of sleep, the while they call on their Lord, in Fear and Hope: and they spend (in charity) out of the sustenance which We have bestowed on them

verses.ar: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ مَّا٘ اُخۡفِيَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قُرَّةِ اَعۡيُنٍۚ جَزَآءًۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Now no person knows what delights of the eye are kept hidden (in reserve) for them - as a reward for their (good) deeds

verses.ar: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ مُؤۡمِنًا كَمَنۡ كَانَ فَاسِقًاؕؔ لَا يَسۡتَوٗنَ࣡‏
verses.en: Is then the man who believes no better than the man who is rebellious and wicked? Not equal are they

verses.ar: اَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ الۡمَاۡوٰيؗ نُزُلًاۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: For those who believe and do righteous deeds are Gardens as hospitable homes, for their (good) deeds

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ فَسَقُوۡا فَمَاۡوٰىهُمُ النَّارُؕ كُلَّمَا٘ اَرَادُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّخۡرُجُوۡا مِنۡهَا٘ اُعِيۡدُوۡا فِيۡهَا وَقِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ ذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.en: As to those who are rebellious and wicked, their abode will be the Fire: every time they wish to get away therefrom, they will be forced thereinto, and it will be said to them: "Taste ye the Penalty of the Fire, the which ye were wont to reject as false

verses.ar: وَلَنُذِيۡقَنَّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡاَدۡنٰي دُوۡنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡاَكۡبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And indeed We will make them taste of the Penalty of this (life) prior to the supreme Penalty, in order that they may (repent and) return

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَاؕ اِنَّا مِنَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ مُنۡتَقِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And who does more wrong than one to whom are recited the Signs of his Lord, and who then turns away therefrom? Verily from those who transgress We shall exact (due) Retribution

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنۡ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ لِّقَآئِهٖ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ هُدًي لِّبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَۚ‏
verses.en: We did indeed aforetime give the Book to Moses: be not then in doubt of its reaching (thee): and We made it a guide to the Children of Israel

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ اَئِمَّةً يَّهۡدُوۡنَ بِاَمۡرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوۡاࣞؕ وَكَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We appointed, from among them, leaders, giving guidance under Our command, so long as they persevered with patience and continued to have faith in Our Signs

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment, in the matters wherein they differ (among themselves)

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ يَمۡشُوۡنَ فِيۡ مَسٰكِنِهِمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍؕ اَفَلَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Does it not teach them a lesson, how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they (now) go to and fro? Verily in that are Signs: Do they not then listen

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا نَسُوۡقُ الۡمَآءَ اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ الۡجُرُزِ فَنُخۡرِجُ بِهٖ زَرۡعًا تَاۡكُلُ مِنۡهُ اَنۡعَامُهُمۡ وَاَنۡفُسُهُمۡؕ اَفَلَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And do they not see that We do drive rain to parched soil (bare of herbage), and produce therewith crops, providing food for their cattle and themselves? Have they not the vision

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡفَتۡحُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They say: "When will this decision be, if ye are telling the truth

verses.ar: قُلۡ يَوۡمَ الۡفَتۡحِ لَا يَنۡفَعُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِيۡمَانُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "On the Day of Decision, no profit will it be to Unbelievers if they (then) believe! nor will they be granted a respite

verses.ar: فَاَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَانۡتَظِرۡ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّنۡتَظِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So turn away from them, and wait: they too are waiting
